# Riyadh Events Hub

> Riyadh Events Hub is the Saudi events and entertainment marketing service of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It markets events, festivals and entertainment brands in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia: on-ground event coverage and content production, influencer invitations and event PR, UGC campaigns for events and festivals, entertainment brand social campaigns, and brand activations inside events. Its proof in the Saudi market is the influUGC client roster itself — Riyadh Season and the Saudi Tourism Authority are real influUGC clients, alongside flynas and Saudia.

## Services (Events & Entertainment Marketing)

- Event Coverage & Content Production: photo and cinematic filming teams on the ground during events — key-moment documentation, short clips published in real time, and a wrap-up film (aftermovie) with organised deliverables.
- Influencer Invitations & Event PR: targeted creator and influencer guest lists for openings, launches and events, with RSVP follow-up and in-event hosting coordination.
- UGC Campaigns for Events & Festivals: participation ideas that get creators and audiences producing content around the event, with spread-content tracking and a collected archive.
- Entertainment Brand Social Campaigns: launch and opening content, seasonal and holiday campaigns, and ongoing content management for destinations, entertainment venues and experience brands.
- Brand Activations Inside Events: experience corners and interactive activations inside existing events, tied to social campaigns before and after the day.

- Process: planning and guest/creator lists before the event, on-ground coverage and real-time publishing during it, wrap-up film and collected content after it, and a full coverage report.
